Tells whether a camera has a stencil buffer, as set with [SetCameraStencil](SetCameraStencil). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.
@param camera  Camera handle.
@returns 1 if the camera has a stencil, 0 if not.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
camera = CreateCamera()
SetCameraStencil camera, True
Print GetCameraStencil(camera)
WaitKey
```
